```{r}
# argument order exercise
print(rep(5, 7))
```
```{r}
# character, numerical, logical
x <- "hello"
print(x)
print(class(x))
y <- 85
print(y)
print(class(y))
z <- TRUE
print(z)
print(class(z))
```
```{r}
# variables of diff types
cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"
treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE
cells_before_1 <- 5415
cells_before_2 <- 8123
cells_after_1 <- 1432
cells_after_2 <- 7543
```

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```{r}
# vectors
cell_ID_vec <- c(cell_ID_1, cell_ID_2)
treated_vec <- c(treated_1, treated_2)
n_before_vec <- c(cells_before_1, cells_before_2)
n_after_vec <- c(cells_after_1, cells_after_2)
```
```{r}
# indexing
```
